subject.title: Settings: add unified usage and spend dashboard

question: Should aggregate cross-provider spend and model history become a permanent top-level Settings destination, or should it live inside an existing overview-style surface?
rationale: Both placements are technically plausible, but the choice establishes long-term navigation and shared-UI maintenance that cannot be inferred safely from the implementation alone.

options.title: Use Existing Overview
options.body: Keep the aggregation model but place the presentation within an existing overview-style surface to limit permanent navigation and one-off UI.

options.title: Approve Dedicated Pane
options.body: Accept Usage & Spend as a permanent top-level Settings destination and own the additional navigation and presentation surface.

options.title: Decline Dashboard
options.body: Keep provider-level cost charts as the supported analytical surface and do not add this aggregate dashboard.

recommendation.title: Use Existing Overview
recommendation.body: Keep the aggregation model but place the presentation within an existing overview-style surface to limit permanent navigation and one-off UI.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the clearest available owner for a permanent product-navigation decision.
